text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Same-week ophthalmology consultation for new distortion and reduced acuity in the left eye, with OCT and fluorescein or OCT angiography as needed
  • Intravitreal aflibercept 2 mg in the left eye every four weeks for three doses, then treat-and-extend by two-week steps while the macula stays dry
  • At each injection visit: best-corrected acuity, OCT, and intraocular pressure before and after injection; teach warning signs of endophthalmitis and retinal detachment
  • Start an AREDS2 supplement (vitamin C 500 mg, vitamin E 400 IU, lutein 10 mg, zeaxanthin 2 mg, zinc 80 mg, copper 2 mg daily) for intermediate AMD in the right eye; no beta-carotene
  • Daily home Amsler grid checks for each eye, with same-day calls for new distortion; dilated examination of the right eye at each retina visit
  • Low-vision rehabilitation: task lighting, magnification, high-contrast marking, home fall-risk review, and a driving assessment
  • Repeat the PHQ-2 at follow-up because vision loss raises the risk of depression

resource.title: Georgia O'Keeffe synthetic care plan
resource.description: Recognize new distortion in one eye as a possible sign of neovascular age-related macular degeneration that needs ophthalmology evaluation within days; follow intravitreal anti-VEGF treatment with acuity, OCT, and pressure checks under the AAO Preferred Practice Pattern; protect the fellow eye with AREDS2 supplements and home Amsler grid monitoring; and support function, safety, and mood with low-vision rehabilitation, in an artist whose central vision was lost before these treatments existed.
